sections.title: Unit 31: Memory Politics and Commemoration, 2010–2026
body: Between 2010 and 2026 public memory in Hungary was a subject of political decisions and debate: memorials, museums, anniversaries and the way the twentieth century was described. Each step was welcomed by some and criticised by others, and historians disagreed about several of them.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: the order of events, attribution, participles, contrast and open questions. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
